title: Saving a shared matrix asks to change prices in every category
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing three new categories made for this test, category A, category B and category C, every tier with its own Markup % rule.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Type a new value in Default's first range.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Click Change All.
  7. Open Settings › Categories.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • The bar counts 1 change.

Step 5:

  • A dialog titled "Change Prices in 3 Categories?" opens.
  • It reads "The" matrix A's name "matrix prices 3 categories:" with category A, category B and category C one per line.
  • Then it reads "Saving changes prices in all 3. Parts already on work orders keep their prices." with Cancel and Change All.
  • The dialog counts categories only: it shows no number of parts or customers, while the 3 categories are listed.

Step 6:

  • The grid saves and the saved message shows.

Step 7:

  • Category A, category B and category C each show the new Default value in their Default column.
